category.description: not-applicable: the duty does not apply to this project. false-positive: the rule is wrong here. accepted-risk: the finding is real and accepted until expires.

reason.description: Why the rule does not apply or the risk is accepted. Shown in the report.

expires.description: Last day the entry applies (YYYY-MM-DD), at most 365 days ahead. Required for accepted-risk.
